# Alpha-Factor-Engine: Research Results (auto-generated)

Generated by `run_pipeline.py --run-test`. Test period evaluated: yes.

Data: Yahoo Finance daily OHLCV snapshot downloaded 2026-10-06T12:27:36+00:00 (649 of 948 historical S&P 500 tickers available), 2006-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Benchmark: SPY.

Periods: train 2007-01-01 to 2015-12-31, validation 2016-01-01 to 2019-12-31, test 2020-01-01 to 2025-12-31.

Execution: signals at close t, trades at close t+1, rebalance every 20 days, beta-neutral signals: True, top/bottom 20% equal-weighted, gross 1.0. Costs per dollar traded: 3.0 bps commission+spread + 3.0 bps slippage.
